title: She's Adopted a High School Boy!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: When Minoru Soramoto's parents vanish and leave him with huge debts, debt collectors nearly have his organs sold, until his neighbor Shiori Kanemochi rescues him, pays the debt and takes him into her home. She dotes on him, finds him too cute and wants to 'keep' him, but reveals nothing about herself. The short-chapter romantic comedy follows their odd cohabitation (Wikipedia; BOOK WALKER blurb; MU Doting Guardian, Obsessive Love).
life_message: Unconditional care from an unexpected benefactor can rescue someone abandoned by their own family.

content.note: Threat from debt collectors at the start (Wikipedia).
Minoru nearly has his organs sold over his parents' debt (Wikipedia).

Ecchi genre, big-breast focus and partial nudity; adult woman doting on a high schooler (AniList and MU Ecchi; MU Older Female Younger Male, Partial Nudity; MangaDex suggestive). Capped: no non-database source confirms the fan service (to verify).

folkways.japan: Loan-shark debt passed to children and the 'onee-san' (older woman) archetype are familiar elements of Japanese comedy manga.

winners_losers: Minoru gains safety and affection; the absent parents are the story's failures. Sympathy lies with Shiori's devotion.
